Class H3SimulationEngine

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.core.H3SimulationEngine
All Implemented Interfaces:
ISimulationEngine
public class H3SimulationEngine extends Object implements ISimulationEngine
H3-based simulation engine. Manages the deterministic simulation loop grounded strictly in physical laws.
